name: UQQC Item Summary
query: SELECT daily.occurredOn AS 'Ngày:Date:100', daily.deviceQc AS 'QC:Data:70', daily.companyName AS 'Công ty:Data:150', daily.sampleCode AS 'Mã hàng:Data:120', daily.pass AS 'Số lượng đạt:Int:110', daily.rework AS 'Số lượng tái sửa:Int:120', daily.defect AS 'Số lượng lỗi:Int:100', daily.pass + daily.defect AS 'Tổng kiểm:Int:100', CASE WHEN daily.pass + daily.defect = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * daily.defect / (daily.pass + daily.defect), 2) END AS 'Tỷ lệ lỗi:Percent:100', COALESCE(totals.totalRework, 0) AS 'Lũy kế tái sửa:Int:120', COALESCE(totals.totalPass, 0) AS 'Lũy kế đạt:Int:110', COALESCE(totals.totalDefect, 0) AS 'Lũy kế lỗi:Int:100', COALESCE(totals.totalPass, 0) + COALESCE(totals.totalDefect, 0) AS 'Lũy kế kiểm:Int:110', CASE WHEN COALESCE(totals.totalPass, 0) + COALESCE(totals.totalDefect, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(totals.totalDefect, 0) / (COALESCE(totals.totalPass, 0) + COALESCE(totals.totalDefect, 0)), 2) END AS 'Tỷ lệ lũy kế:Percent:120' FROM (SELECT DATE(DATE_ADD(e.occurred_at, INTERVAL 7 HOUR)) AS occurredOn, CASE WHEN LOCATE('QC1', UPPER(device.device_name)) > 0 AND (LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name)) = 0 OR LOCATE('QC1', UPPER(device.device_name)) < LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name))) THEN 'QC1' WHEN LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name)) > 0 THEN 'QC2' ELSE '' END AS deviceQc, company.company_code AS companyCode, company.company_name AS companyName, product.product_code AS sampleCode, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'pass' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS pass, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'rework' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS rework, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'defect' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS defect FROM `tabUQQC Inspection Event` e JOIN `tabFactory Device` device ON device.name = e.device JOIN `tabProduction Line` line ON line.name = e.line AND line.company = device.company JOIN `tabCompany` company ON company.name = line.company JOIN `tabProduct` product ON product.name = e.product WHERE e.occurred_at >= DATE_SUB(CONCAT(%(from_date)s, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 7 HOUR) AND e.occurred_at < DATE_SUB(DATE_ADD(CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 00:00:00'), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL 7 HOUR) AND (COALESCE(%(company)s, '') = '' OR company.name = %(company)s) AND (COALESCE(%(product)s, '') = '' OR product.name = %(product)s) GROUP BY DATE(DATE_ADD(e.occurred_at, INTERVAL 7 HOUR)), deviceQc, company.company_code, company.company_name, product.product_code) daily LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN LOCATE('QC1', UPPER(device.device_name)) > 0 AND (LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name)) = 0 OR LOCATE('QC1', UPPER(device.device_name)) < LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name))) THEN 'QC1' WHEN LOCATE('QC2', UPPER(device.device_name)) > 0 THEN 'QC2' ELSE '' END AS deviceQc, company.company_code AS companyCode, product.product_code AS sampleCode, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'pass' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS totalPass, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'rework' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS totalRework, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_kind = 'defect' THEN e.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS totalDefect FROM `tabUQQC Inspection Event` e JOIN `tabFactory Device` device ON device.name = e.device JOIN `tabProduction Line` line ON line.name = e.line AND line.company = device.company JOIN `tabCompany` company ON company.name = line.company JOIN `tabProduct` product ON product.name = e.product GROUP BY deviceQc, company.company_code, product.product_code) totals ON totals.deviceQc = daily.deviceQc AND totals.companyCode = daily.companyCode AND totals.sampleCode = daily.sampleCode WHERE (COALESCE(%(qc)s, '') = '' OR daily.deviceQc = %(qc)s) ORDER BY daily.occurredOn, daily.deviceQc, daily.companyCode, daily.sampleCode
